title: Degree-zero fibre system comparison
statement: ∃ b : formalFibreCohomologySystem f y (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) 0 ≅ formalFibreSectionsSystem f y, True

proof.text: At each fibre level use Mathlib rightDerivedZeroIsoSelf for the left exact global-sections functor. Compose with global sections of tensorPullbackObjUnitToUnit, then restrict scalars along the completed-local-ring action. This constructs levelIso with no choice of arbitrary witnesses.

Apply the projection adjunction Hom equivalence to the transition h-map composed with pushforward of the earlier unit isomorphism. Naturality of pushforwardCongr and pushforwardComp moves that isomorphism across the composition comparison. The adjunction unit characterization reduces the result to functoriality of the structure-sheaf map. This proves unitTransition.

Specialize ModuleCohomologyFMapData.map_zero_augmentation to the resolution data chosen in moduleCohomologyFMap. The restriction along inverse-image top = top is the identity by the presheaf map_id law. Cancel the canonical augmentation isomorphisms to obtain degreeZero_naturality. Evaluate unitTransition on top sections, use naturality of the unit morphism under restriction, and combine the two squares to prove levelIso_naturality.
NatTrans.ofOpSequence assembles levelIso.hom using adjacent transition naturality. Every component is an isomorphism, so NatIso.isIso_of_isIso_app gives the required system isomorphism.
